# Provenance + integrity record for the vendored ui scripts (#577 — the #332
# recipe's ui variant). The sha256s below are ENFORCED by ui/vendor_test.go
# (the uiVendorScripts pin table). An upgrade is the full recipe, in ONE
# commit: the vendored blob + the sha256 here + the pin table in
# ui/vendor_test.go + the go:embed list in ui/embed.go + the handleAsset case
# list in internal/server/server.go + the /assets script tags in summary.html
# and disclosure.html. The #577 customManagers in renovate.json read the
# version from those REFERENCE files (config:recommended's
# :ignoreModulesAndTests preset adds **/vendor/** to ignorePaths; the
# standard ignores are deliberately not overridden — provenance here is
# hand-maintained, same as internal/report/vendor/).
#
# WHY NO BREAKOUT GUARD (deliberate difference from the report variant): the
# report blobs are inlined as template.JS/template.CSS and need the
# </script>/</style> hazard checks; these ui blobs are served as EXTERNAL
# responses (Content-Type application/javascript + nosniff, handleAsset) —
# the html/template escape/breakout class has no reach here. The guards that
# DO transfer are the sha256 lock and the versioned-name invariants in
# ui/vendor_test.go.
#
# SANITIZER MODEL (amended by #578 follow-up A): DOMPurify remains the
# PRIMARY content boundary for the untrusted-markdown render path of
# summary.html + disclosure.html (marked.parse -> DOMPurify.sanitize ->
# innerHTML); since #578-A the server additionally ships a route-scoped
# nonce CSP on those pages (script-src 'self' 'nonce-…'), so a sanitizer
# bypass yielding script execution is dead — the worst residual is
# markup-level abuse (allowlisted-tag defacement / same-origin phishing),
# which no header can fix because the page IS the trusted origin. The CSP
# is the backstop for the execution class; the sanitizer policy stays the
# load-bearing boundary.
#
# LIMITATION (the sha lock's blind spot, #578 review round): the lock
# detects UNCOORDINATED drift only — a single commit that moves the blob
# AND the sha256 here AND the pin table together passes every test. The
# one guard for a coordinated swap is the REVIEWER's out-of-band
# cross-check: on every bump, independently re-derive the npm tarball's
# sha512 against the registry's dist.integrity and the inner file's
# sha256 against the committed bytes — never trust the diff's own numbers.
#
# marked-18.1.1.min.js (the #678 minor bump from 18.0.13; the #332 recipe)
#   source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.1/lib/marked.umd.js
#   npm anchor: registry.npmjs.org/marked/-/marked-18.1.1.tgz
#   dist.integrity (of the .tgz, not of the inner file): sha512-zEGgrtUG8crk+TrMacJSVABU4DYDDkS8uqgU3ohrn/2fW9C2AEfUrO3m6IhpIpQpl7YcVpiXXC9cSMWDANT3dg==
#   sha256: b82b9334406d8bdd16b6236c08de1cb65b2a859873ca9503d9cc0b292ca3c12a
#   verified: 2026-10-13 — the tarball sha512 was re-derived and MATCHED the
#         registry dist.integrity at write time (its sha1 also matched
#         dist.shasum); the committed bytes are the tarball's
#         lib/marked.umd.js, verbatim, 47,956 bytes, banner "marked v18.1.1"
#         (the 18.x tarball ships no root .min.js since v16 — the
#         -<semver>.min.js NAME is kept for the version-suffix + notifier
#         conventions; the file IS upstream-minified; jsdelivr's synthesized
#         .umd.min.js was deliberately NOT vendored: it strips the version
#         banner and is not a registry artifact).
#         Upstream delta 18.0.13 -> 18.1.1: NINETEEN changes across THREE
#         releases (re-derived from the upstream release notes, not the
#         renovate body — the #583 review round's standing correction; the
#         branch body excerpts ONE of them).
#         18.0.14: #4095 (indented lines in setext heading text), #4076
#         (decode numeric character references in text), #4101 (keep text
#         after an empty nested blockquote), #4086 (preserve internal tabs
#         in list item content), #4091 (strip whitespace when normalizing
#         link reference labels), #4067 (GFM protocol autolinks).
#         18.1.0: #4106 (avoid CUBIC BACKTRACKING on unicode whitespace in a
#         link destination — complexity/DoS-relevant on attacker-authored
#         markdown, the headline of this bump), #4107 (reject unbalanced
#         parentheses in link destinations), #4100 (CLI config load — not on
#         this app's path), + feature #4070 (linkParenPossible lexer state,
#         fail-fast for link token generation — the companion to #4106/#4107).
#         18.1.1: #4121 (make walkTokens LINEAR by appending values in place
#         — complexity-relevant), #4114 (match pre/script/style/textarea as
#         WHOLE tag names in html blocks), #4124 (let indented and type 3-5
#         html blocks interrupt a paragraph), #4115 (end a blockquote before
#         a lazy line after a heading, hr or html block), #4111 (keep a
#         decoded character reference from forming a new one), #4117 (keep a
#         backslash in a code span from hiding emphasis), #4123 (preserve
#         enclosing link state after parsing images), #4119 (respect tab
#         stops in list continuation indentation), #4113 (CLI empty-string
#         input — not on this app's path), + perf #4082 (avoid repeated raw
#         string copies in nested lists — complexity-relevant).
#         RENDER DIFFERENTIAL (raw marked.parse, 18.0.13's committed blob vs
#         these bytes, out-of-band at write time). The browser-smoke canary
#         (testdata/browser-smoke/golden_input.md, every MD_SANITIZE class):
#         BYTE-IDENTICAL, 1,905 bytes both sides — golden_expected.html does
#         not move on this bump. A 21-shape corpus, ONE SHAPE PER FIX:
#         16 identical, 5 NAMED deltas, each the corresponding fix's own
#         intended behavior change — #4076 ("a &#35; b" -> "a # b": numeric
#         character references in TEXT are now decoded, then escaped again on
#         output), #4086 (internal tabs in a list item are preserved rather
#         than expanded), #4107 (an unbalanced paren in a link destination no
#         longer forms a link — strictly tighter), #4115 (a blockquote now
#         ends before a lazy line following a heading/hr/html block), #4124
#         (an indented or type-3-5 html block now interrupts a paragraph).
#         SANITIZER-BOUNDARY probes on the one decoding change (#4076), 7
#         shapes: a decoded "&#60;script&#62;" is RE-ESCAPED on output
#         ("&lt;script&gt;") and forms no tag; the href and title entity
#         shapes render identically at both versions. No new raw-markup or
#         event-handler class; DOMPurify (unmoved by this commit) remains the
#         content boundary and the route-scoped nonce CSP is unaffected.
#         STATED LIMIT, honestly: this is the ONE-SHAPE-PER-FIX differential,
#         not the #583 round's two-oracle (raw + post-DOMPurify) sweep over a
#         real scan-summary corpus. That wider sweep is OWED to this PR's
#         review round — the 2 deltas #583 found were invisible to its own
#         first, narrower corpus, which is why this limit is written down
#         instead of implied.
#
# dompurify-3.4.17.min.js (the #717 patch bump from 3.4.15; the #332 recipe)
#   source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js
#   npm anchor: registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.4.17.tgz
#   dist.integrity (of the .tgz, not of the inner file): sha512-B/pSlYVHQ58kqISD/yDjuJ1yfzI34m1gF4lAod2bwSRhiN4K5Cl3H8Af7hqB2PmTL911tdEudnnXn5FnhRoz0w==
#   sha256: cd37898f9782adf54820c413191b5691803f0f137c799d6edcfd38523b4c2c31
#   verified: 2026-10-16 — the tarball sha512 was re-derived and MATCHED the
#         registry dist.integrity at write time (its sha1 also matched
#         dist.shasum, 074bbb24eaa419535ac19ffe7f663104b0e1543d); the
#         committed bytes are the tarball's dist/purify.min.js, verbatim,
#         29,828 bytes, banner "DOMPurify 3.4.17". The out-of-band
#         cross-check the LIMITATION note above demands was ALSO run: the
#         jsDelivr copy of dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js is
#         BYTE-IDENTICAL to the registry tarball's inner file (same sha256),
#         and the SUPERSEDED 3.4.15 blob's own sha256 was re-derived from the
#         3.4.15 registry tarball and matched the record it is replacing
#         (f263b053…, 29,369 B) — i.e. the previous entry was genuine and the
#         extraction convention is unchanged. Two cosmetic byte-shape
#         differences from 3.4.15, kept verbatim for fidelity: the file no
#         longer ends in a newline, and a `;` precedes the trailing
#         sourceMappingURL comment (3.4.16 migrated the build from rollup to
#         rolldown — a MINIFIER change, not a source change). The
#         sourceMappingURL still references a map the /assets route never
#         serves (not allowlisted in handleAsset) — cosmetic.
#         Upstream delta 3.4.15 -> 3.4.17: TWELVE changes across TWO releases
#         (re-derived from the upstream GitHub release notes, not the
#         renovate body — the #583 review round's standing correction).
#         3.4.16 (2026-09-23): IN_PLACE node removal with hooks; IN_PLACE
#         sanitization with raw-text roots; ESM default exports landing in
#         CommonJS declarations; the rollup -> rolldown build migration
#         (performance); dependency bumps.
#         3.4.17 (2026-10-12): IN_PLACE + SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES + shadow roots;
#         IN_PLACE handling of nodes that hooks or custom elements touch
#         during sanitization; the SMIL `attributeName` guard in XHTML mode;
#         hardening of smaller edge cases (namespaces, literal-text
#         elements, `isValidAttribute()`); a purify-edge compatibility test
#         runner; an IN_PLACE README risk note; dependency bumps.
#         NO ADVISORY IDS in either release — this is a currency/hygiene bump
#         of the sole sanitizer, not a claim that a known exploit is closed.
#         REACH, stated honestly: this app calls `DOMPurify.sanitize(string,
#         MD_SANITIZE)` and assigns the returned STRING to innerHTML. It sets
#         no IN_PLACE, no SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, no RETURN_DOM*, no hooks, no
#         setConfig, and touches no shadow root (grep-verified across all
#         four embedded pages), and the pages are HTML, never XHTML — so the
#         IN_PLACE family (most of both releases) and the XHTML-mode SMIL
#         guard are OFF THIS APP'S PATH. The on-path items are the 3.4.17
#         namespace / literal-text-element / isValidAttribute hardening.
#         SANITIZE DIFFERENTIAL (the two-oracle sweep #583's review round
#         declared OWED and #678's narrower one-shape corpus did not pay —
#         run here, out-of-band, jsdom in a vm realm per version, the
#         MD_SANITIZE golden copied verbatim from ui/vendor_test.go):
#         ORACLE 1, 50 raw shapes (one per ALLOWED_TAGS/ALLOWED_ATTR class,
#         one per FORBID floor entry, the javascript:/data:/vbscript:/
#         protocol-relative/entity-encoded URL families, on*-handler shapes,
#         the mXSS families named by the release notes — noscript, svg
#         foreignObject, mglyph+style, table+form, annotation-xml — the
#         literal-text elements — textarea, title, xmp, plaintext, iframe
#         srcdoc — the SMIL attributeName/animate/xlink namespace shapes,
#         custom elements, template, slot, and the SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES
#         mustache/ERB expression shapes): 50 of 50 BYTE-IDENTICAL, 0 deltas.
#         The execution-class assertion held on BOTH versions for all 50: no
#         script/iframe/svg/math/style/form/img/object/embed/link/base/meta
#         element, no on* attribute, and no javascript:/vbscript: URL
#         survives the policy at either version.
#         ORACLE 2, the pages' REAL pipeline (marked.parse -> sanitize ->
#         the innerHTML string): the browser-smoke canary
#         testdata/browser-smoke/golden_input.md renders BYTE-IDENTICAL,
#         1,565 bytes both sides — golden_expected.html does not move on this
#         bump — plus a 10-shape markdown corpus (raw-html script/img, GFM
#         autolink, javascript: link, table, code fence, an html block whose
#         attribute value contains '>', numeric character references, nested
#         blockquote+list, heading attr): 10 of 10 identical, 0 deltas.
#         PROTOTYPE-POLLUTION re-verification (the defense-in-depth claim
#         ui/vendor_test.go records): polluting Object.prototype with
#         ADD_TAGS / ALLOWED_TAGS / ALLOW_UNKNOWN_PROTOCOLS inside the
#         sanitizer's own realm leaves the output byte-identical at BOTH
#         3.4.15 and 3.4.17 — the config reader still ignores inherited keys.
#         STATED LIMIT, honestly: the corpora above are hand-built shape
#         corpora, not a sweep over a real scan-summary archive; a behaviour
#         change reachable only from markup no shape above spells would be
#         invisible to it. What the differential DOES establish is that every
#         policy class this app pins, every family the two releases' own
#         notes name, and the live golden render are unmoved.
